derivation: from a compound of a derivative of G1364 (δίς) and a derivative of (to cut);
def: to bisect, i.e. (by extension) to flog severely

occurrences.text: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
